package.name: imu_node
package.description: IMU driver node: publishes KITTI OXTS inertial data as sensor_msgs/Imu (/imu/data): fused orientation (roll/pitch/yaw -> quaternion), angular velocity and linear acceleration in the vehicle/IMU frame. Mirrors a real IMU driver (e.g. xsens/vectornav) on the ROS bus.
